studio.note: TRIBE v2 predictions for an average subject, not measurements from real viewers. Per-second network percentages are a 0-100 normalisation of TRIBE grid responses grouped by coarse geometric zones.

caveats: TRIBE v2 outputs are model predictions for an average subject on the fsaverage5 mesh, not measurements from real viewers.
Predictions lag stimulus by 5s (hemodynamic delay); all times cited are stimulus seconds.
Predictions do not establish emotion, persuasion, or purchase intent.
Region names are coarse geometric mesh zones, not precise anatomical areas.
region_mean_z values are all ~0.0 and provide no differentiating evidence.
verdict.lateralisation_note: Laterality ratio -0.5261 (negative = right-leaning) with hemisphere means right 0.0636 vs left 0.0198; predicted response is slightly right-weighted on average, not a claim about individual viewers.
